Aberfan disaster 60th anniversary marked by Royals, survivors

The 60th anniversary of the Aberfan disaster, a significant event in Welsh mining history, was observed with participation from the Royal family, survivors, and affected families. The disaster, which occurred in Aberfan, Wales, profoundly impacted the mining community. Reports highlight the experiences of survivors, with one recalling being covered in a sheet and presumed dead.
